body:
## Expected Behavior
When an activity panics, the panic trace is logged at the [activity task handler level,](https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-go/blob/e47a8d2466c79b5d17a1664360f82f1e376bca2f/internal/internal_task_handlers.go#L2308-L2316) but not at the caller level.

## Actual Behavior
It gets converted into Application errors with traces, so it ends up in history, but never logged from a workflow POV. Other SDKs log the panic trace.
